name: 12211 · Albany, NY
findings: ZIP 12211 (Albany) has 84 nonprofit organizations. 38 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 36 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 12211 (Albany) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 12211 (Albany) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.2 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 36 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.
